comment: Replicated (lab-c, round 3; finalises the round-2 interim review). c1 is a three-body statement and is now tested by one three-body run: 2026-11-20/r2/lab-c/001 (B, C, C equilateral, side 5, at rest, T=2). Judged error 0.00714 against a bar of 0.03 (3 x predicted_error 0.01). Per-coordinate rms 0.0505 against the claim's 0.07 bar. The zero-force null on the same run is 0.140, so the run discriminates the pairwise sum from no force. No census events. The other three cited runs (2026-11-19/r1/lab-c/023 B-C, 024 C-C, 025 B-B; two-body at side 5) lie inside the claim's stated domain (species B, C; separation 5.00; up to three particles) and score at the noise floor (0.0070-0.0071). Their pair coefficients fit P-0005 to 1.007 +/- 0.009 (one coupling scale per run). Scope: one three-body run and three pair runs, all at side 5, T <= 2. Not tested: other triangles or separations, moving particles, and T > 2.
